_doc: Learned QC lessons, phrased POSITIVELY (FLUX is guidance-distilled at CFG=1, so negative prompts like 'no X' are ignored — always state the positive opposite). 'global' constraints are injected into EVERY panel prompt (prevention). 'by_tag' constraints are applied when repairing a panel with that issue tag. When a rework proves a fix, record it here so quality is maintained, not re-discovered. Update via: node 02b-verify.mjs --learn-global "..." or --learn tag="...".
global: Draw every character as a complete full-body figure, from head to feet, standing whole in the scene.
Each accessory belongs to exactly one character: the top hat appears only on Clerval; the round glasses appear only on Victor; every other character keeps their own separate look.

by_tag.cropped_figure: Show each character's complete body from head to toe, standing whole.
by_tag.extra_figures: Include only the exact characters listed, each a complete separate full body, with empty background around them.
by_tag.identity_drift: Keep each character's fixed signature identical to every other panel (glasses = Victor, top hat = Clerval, bald hollow-eyed ghoul = the Creature).
by_tag.scene_mismatch: Show the stated action clearly and literally.
by_tag.capzone_blocked: Keep the caption zone as a plain empty area of background.
by_tag.style_drift: Keep a clean thin black-and-white cartoon line style, light and tidy.
